name: Pricing Toggle
description: A cursor clicks Monthly→Yearly: the toggle thumb springs across, every price rolls digit by digit like an odometer, a "Save 20%" badge pops, and the cursor hovers the highlighted plan.
move: A cursor clicks Monthly→Yearly: the toggle thumb springs across, every price rolls digit by digit like an odometer, a "Save 20%" badge pops, and the cursor hovers the highlighted plan.
how: Prices are per-digit clipped 0–9 stacks rolled by yPercent with cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), staggered per card and column, with a blur yoyo at speed. The thumb uses a single-overshoot ease (0.34,1.45,0.64,1). The cursor follows eased, sideways-bowed segments computed from measured element centres.
adapt: Set data-from / data-to per card (same digit count), the billing lines and features. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
